name: agentic-os
description: Agentic OS: orquestador de agentes de IA de escritorio

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n backend,desktop -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm -w desktop run tauri dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:spikes
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:desktop && npm run lint:spikes
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint:frontend: npm -w frontend run lint && npm -w frontend run format:check && npm -w frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm -w desktop run tauri build -- --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.test:packaged: npm run build:backend && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-packaged.ps1
scripts.lint:spikes: uv run --project spikes ruff check spikes && uv run --project spikes ruff format --check spikes
